verdict.rationale: Maritime is a cloud platform for hosting agents, not an agent itself, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server or MCP endpoint. What it does document is an agent-operable CLI, a REST API with an OpenAPI spec, and a paste-in prompt for assistants; these are adjacent surfaces and do not count as an MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
